title: Manual State Machine Futures (Grotesque Poll)
pattern: Manually implementing state enums inside `Future::poll` to track progress across yield points.
why_bad: Extremely complex, fragile, and difficult to verify correct borrowing semantics across yields.
detection: Manual implementation of the `Future` trait containing a state machine match statement.
counterexample: Writing low-level leaf futures (like channel receivers or timer implementations) where no async/await syntax exists.
fix: Use standard compiler-generated state machines via `async fn` and `.await`.
